questions.why: McLean, a trucking mogul, created it.

questions.q: What problem did Vietnam's logistics face in 1965?
a: Only one deepwater port and limited transport

questions.q: What economic effect did containerization have on insurance?
What was a major barrier to shipping before containers?
questions.why: Regulations and fixed rates hindered competition.
